result.title: Reaching Is Not Finding: Map-Anchored Visual Prompting for the Last Mile of Aerial Vision-Language Navigation
result.summary: Aerial vision-language navigation (VLN) asks a drone to find an object described in natural language. The description usually locates the object relative to named landmarks, such as streets and buildings. We observe that current navigators often bring the drone close to the target and then stop at the wrong place: they reach the target without finding it. This gap is shared by navigators of very different designs, from imitation learners to a fine-tuned 7B vision-language model. A simple test reveals the cause. When we replace the target object in the instruction with another one next to the same landmarks, no navigator goes to it, and most stop where they did before. Navigators learn to reach the landmarks, not to identify the described object. We therefore propose MAP-VP, a plug-and-play module for the last step. After any navigator stops, MAP-VP draws the landmarks named in the instruction onto the drone's current view, using the landmark outlines that the benchmark provides on a map. A fine-tuned 4B vision-language model then locates the target relative to these landmarks. The training data are generated automatically from the benchmark annotations. Neither drawing the landmarks nor fine-tuning helps much alone, but together they are highly effective. Without retraining any navigator, MAP-VP significantly improves all six navigators we test on CityNav. It roughly doubles the success rate of the two strongest trained navigators, raising HETT from 25.9% to 54.6% and FlightGPT from 24.2% to 48.9%, whereas CityNav's official detector-based last step adds less than two points to HETT.

AI.brief_summary: 论文针对空中视觉语言导航中「到达却未找到」的失败现象，用替换指令目标物的对照实验表明导航器只学会抵达地标而非识别目标，并提出即插即用的 MAP-VP：在导航器停下后把指令提及的地标轮廓绘制到当前视角上，再由微调的 4B VLM 定位目标。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「停下位置错误」的诊断与后置视觉提示可分别对照 LVR 的 STOP 决策和视觉证据注入问题，可供核查的是：把结构化地标显式画进视觉输入是否等价于一种外部化的证据筛选，以及该反事实替换测试能否用于检验 latent 内容是否真被答案使用。
